name: Alabama
status_why: The election-night pages answered a script but hold no election between elections; whether they need form postbacks is not known yet.
system: State-built: the Secretary of State's 'Election Night Reporting' (ASP.NET WebForms) on www2.alabamavotes.gov, fed by the 67 probate judges; certified precinct files later on sos.alabama.gov.

results_page.label: Alabama Secretary of State: election night reporting

election.how_to_find: Load the election-night page once in the last week of October for its page names and election code.

feeds.address: https://www2.alabamavotes.gov/electionNight/ (page shows the current election only; earlier years used statewideResultsByContest.aspx?ecode=<election code>)
feeds.updates: As counties upload on election night; interval not stated.
feeds.note: 200 to a script on 2026-10-09 (after one lost DNS lookup), but the page is an empty WebForms shell between elections: no election is loaded now. Whether the night's pages need ViewState postbacks is untested; plan for HTML scraping.

The Elections Data Downloads page (https://www.sos.alabama.gov/alabama-votes/voter/election-data) answered 200 to a script on 2026-10-09 and lists the 2024 general precinct zip. Columns: Contest Title, Party, Candidate, a column per precinct, then ABSENTEE and PROVISIONAL (al.py).

races_in_feed: Election night: federal, statewide, legislature specials, judges, county offices, county school boards (all partisan in Alabama). Cities vote at their own municipal elections, not Nov 3.
local: Some probate offices publish their own election-night results (Jefferson, Madison, Mobile, Montgomery are the largest); addresses not checked today.
how_counted: Each county's probate judge reports its count on election night. Alabama has no early in-person voting.
count_order: Absentee and provisional counts appear only in the certified precinct files, after the night.
vote_types: Only in the certified precinct files: an ABSENTEE column and a PROVISIONAL column beside the precincts. Alabama has no early in-person voting, so absentee vs. election day is the whole split, and it arrives after the night.

certify.rule: Members of Congress and the Legislature receive certificates within 10 days of the Secretary of State receiving each county's returns (Ala. Code 17-12-21); county returns are stated at noon on the second Friday after the election (Ala. Code 17-12-15).
certify.local_rule: Second Friday after the election (Ala. Code 17-12-15).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
certify.confirm: The body's name is not in the source read; to confirm before it is printed on a page.

condition: The election-night pages are empty between elections; whether they need form postbacks is untested.
rehearsal: No replayable past night; the 2024 general certified precinct zip for the model.
scout_plan: Readable with care. In the last week of October, load the ENR page once to learn its page names and election code; on election night scrape the statewide contest pages every 10 minutes (federal, statewide, county offices), labelled unofficial. Use the certified precinct zip (with its absentee column) for the count-order and roll-off predictors afterwards. If the ENR pages need form postbacks, write the reader to replay the page's own form, never anything more.
